title: Stat counter
description: One big number that counts up with a progress ring, a label and an on-screen source line. Every number needs a real, named source.

suffix.description: Text after the number (e.g. %, x, k).

locale.description: Number formatting locale (e.g. en-US: 1,234.5 / de-DE: 1.234,5 / tr-TR: 1.234,5).

label.default: Replace with what the number measures
label.description: What the number measures, one short line.

source.default: Source: name of the study, year (required)
source.description: Where the number comes from (name, year). Shown on screen; never leave the placeholder.

ringPercent.description: How full the ring gets (0-100). 0 hides the ring (use it when the value is not a share).

lang.description: Language of the copy (BCP 47, e.g. en, tr, de). Sets <html lang>, which drives uppercase rules (tr: i -> İ).

duration.description: Scene length in seconds. new-scene.sh --params also rewrites data-duration to match.

checks: the source line names a real source
